headline: Flash Quiz Game — Simultaneous Quiz Race for ESL Classrooms
outcomes: Students consolidate vocabulary, grammar, and topic knowledge under timed conditions — retrieval practice that sticks
Build speed and automaticity: repeated exposure to target language at pace reduces hesitation in real communication
Every student answers every question simultaneously — no dead time, no passenger seats
Instant answer reveal creates a natural comprehension check moment after each question
howItWorks: The AI generates 10–20 topic-relevant questions covering vocabulary, grammar, or comprehension
All students see the question on their device at the same time and submit their answer before the timer runs out
Points are awarded for both accuracy and speed — early correct answers score highest
Live leaderboard updates after every question so the class can track the race in real time
teacherUseCases: Mid-lesson comprehension check — run a 10-question Flash Quiz after input to see who understood before moving on
End-of-unit vocabulary review — generate questions around the unit topic to surface gaps before the test
Warm-up retrieval — start class with a 5-minute quiz on last lesson's content to activate prior knowledge

faq.q: How are the quiz questions generated?
faq.a: The AI creates questions matched to your topic and difficulty level — covering vocabulary definitions, grammar choices, comprehension, and topic facts. You can regenerate the set before starting if any questions don't fit.

Speed matters, but accuracy matters more. A fast wrong answer scores zero; a slower correct answer still earns full points. The scoring formula rewards students who get it right first, while still giving points to everyone who answers correctly.

faq.q: What happens if a student joins late?
faq.a: Late joiners pick up from the current question — they won't see questions they missed, but they're included in the leaderboard going forward. Their score reflects only the questions they answered.

faq.q: Can I use my own questions instead of AI-generated ones?
faq.a: Not in the current version — Flash Quiz is designed for instant, on-demand generation. If you want full custom question sets, Vocab Sprint or Sentence Scramble give you more manual control over content.

Difficulty is tied to the session level you set (Beginner through Advanced). Beginner questions use simple recall and clear multiple-choice options; Advanced questions include inference, nuance, and open-form input.

faq.q: Is Flash Quiz free to use?
faq.a: Yes, Flash Quiz is free. Students join through a shared browser link — no app download or student account needed.
